# Excited to Announce: Joining the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉

After working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm thrilled to share that I've been appointed to the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**. 

It's been incredibly rewarding to see how this standard has evolved and the real-world impact it's having across healthcare organizations. I'm genuinely excited about the opportunity to help shape the future direction of CDS Hooks and contribute to its continued growth and adoption.

**A quick note to the community:** If you're already implementing CDS Hooks, please consider adding your implementation to the [CDS Hooks Availability wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability). Visibility into real-world implementations helps demonstrate the standard's value and inspires other organizations to get involved.

For those exploring CDS Hooks but not yet implementing it—I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate the implementation process. Whether you have questions about the standard, architecture, integration, or best practices, I'd be happy to discuss how CDS Hooks can benefit your organization.

Let's continue to advance clinical decision support together! 💪

#HealthIT #CDS #Interoperability #HL7 #HealthcareInnovation
